verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a full export that can be scheduled to run automatically, which suits archival use. Properties are turned into front-matter values and collections into CSV files, and the docs call the export "fully human- and machine-readable" for reuse in other apps. A REST API with a published OpenAPI spec also gives programmatic access to content. Missing for 10: the export docs excerpt never explicitly names Markdown (it is implied only by front matter), no JSON export format is evidenced, notes are not shown to be stored natively as open files, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.
